messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH latency + 5xx spike on /v1/generate for region us-west-2. Alert auto-closed at 2026-03-12T09:10:02Z after fallback to smaller model.

mike_oncall: we mitigated by routing ~40% of traffic to the v1-fallback model and bumping instance count on the endpoint. Root cause looks like a memory pressure regression in the new attention kernel.

jess: can we get a short customer impact summary? which customers saw errors vs increased latency?

priya: preliminary numbers: ~22k requests affected over 18m window, peak error rate 6.2% for the region. 3 customers had >1% of calls fail (accts: acct-phi, acct-nimbus, acct-redwood-sample). No data exfiltration.

linda-support: customer outreach draft posted to #support-drafts: "We experienced degraded responses in us-west-2 between 08:52–09:10 UTC; fallback served slightly older model with higher latency. We will follow up with root cause and remediation ETA." needs legal brief review before send.

dan: proposing postmortem meeting: tomorrow 16:00 UTC. If that works for SRE/product/engineers. cc @sre-lead @mike_oncall

sre-lead: i can chair. RCA lead: @mike_oncall. Draft timeline in this thread, please add corrections.

priya: timeline (draft):
```
08:51:12 UTC - first autoscaler warning (memory high)
08:52:03 UTC - first 5xx spike observed (~0.7% of traffic)
08:58:45 UTC - deploy 2026-03-12T08:45 rolled out to 50% (candidate change: attention kernel v2.3)
09:02:10 UTC - errors climb to 3.1%, mitigation: increase endpoint instances
09:05:30 UTC - apply routing rule to shift 40% to v1-fallback
09:09:58 UTC - error rate down to 0.2%, latency slowly recovering
09:10:02 UTC - incident auto-closed by bot (fallback in place)
```

mike_oncall: timeline looks right. Additional note: heap fragmentation on p3s showed in metrics around 08:57, correlates with kernel v2.3 when kv-cache hot paths used.

jess: action items idea list (assignments tentative):
- revert attention kernel v2.3 on canary + run mem-profiling (owner: mike_oncall)
- add targeted e2e perf tests for kv-cache hot paths (owner: dan)
- customer outreach + legal approval + send (owner: linda-support, reviewer: legal-bot)
- add circuit-breaker to routing policy to detect rapid mem growth (owner: sre-lead)
- add post-deploy mem smoke test to CI (owner: priya)

priya: i'm going to create GH issues for each item and link them to the postmortem doc. i'll assign provisional owners.

jess: peer-review process for the RCA: 48h for technical review, then biz/legal review. criteria for sign-off: timeline verified, root cause hypothesis with evidence + follow-up actions, customer outreach copy approved, and mitigation validated in staging.

legal-bot: quick note: outreach must avoid language implying liability. provide exact wording to review; allow 24h for turnaround.

linda-support: copy updated in draft and pushed to support-drafts link (internal). pinging legal for review. once legal thumbs up, i'll queue messages to impacted accounts + status page blurb.

mike_oncall: i'll start the revert PR and attach mem-profiles. tagging @dan for e2e test work.

priya: GH issues created: https://gh.internal/rw/incident-2213456789/actions (links in real thread). I've added checkboxes and ETA fields.

jess: reviewers: @dan, @sre-lead for tech; @linda-support + @legal-bot for customer comms review. please add yourselves to the reviewers list on the doc.

sre-lead: propose we mark two high-priority actions as P0: (1) revert kernel on canary, (2) add mem smoke test. Others P1.

linda-support: noting customer impact: acct-phi reported 3 degraded requests that affected an internal demo. i'll offer 1-week extended trial credit and include postmortem link when published.

mike_oncall: update as I make progress. expecting revert PR in 2h, smoke test follow-up by EOD.

priya: schedule confirmed for postmortem: 2026-03-13 16:00 UTC. calendar invite sent to reviewers & engineers.

jess: final step before we close this thread: please react with :white_check_mark: in next 24h when you have completed your assigned task or added a realistic ETA in GH issues. i'll collect sign-off after reviewers confirm.

mike_oncall: ✅ taking ownership of revert & profiling.

dan: ✅ starting e2e tests work.

sre-lead: ✅ will add circuit-breaker ticket and review PRs.

linda-support: ✅ will get legal sign-off then send outreach.

jess: thanks all — this will be the canonical postmortem thread. i'll stitch the final RCA writeup (timeline, contributing factors, impact summary, action items, owner ETAs) and drop it here for final peer review 48h after the meeting.

incident-bot: Note: This thread will be pinned to #postmortems and archived after RCA sign-off."
